newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Wednesday 110,000-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Wednesday 110,000-USDA.

text.p: USDA said Wednesday's estimate for interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog marketings was 110,000 head, compared with 113,000 a week ago and 109,000 a year ago. Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts $0.50 per cwt lower than midsession Tuesday.
Sows: steady-4.00 higher, most advance weights over 500 lbs. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 43.50 -45.00 44.00 -45.50

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct. carcass Yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
